title: Module 20 — Kubernetes Operations
description: Operate one Deployment on a real single-node cluster: inject config with a ConfigMap and Secret, add health probes and watch a failing one restart a pod, set resource requests/limits, and ship a rolling update you roll back in one command. All work is scoped to a throwaway k8s-ops namespace.
